name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: Scroll a row of items endlessly; pauses on hover and stops for reduced motion.
a11y: The duplicate copy is aria-hidden so screen readers read the items once.
Pauses on hover and focus; animation is off under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Scroll to the right instead of the left. Default false.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Stop when the pointer is over it or focus is inside. Default true.
